value.rationale: The invariant is the number of fixed filters of a modal necessity operation, a natural intrinsic semantic statistic. The theorem classifies every T+4 stable modality on the first non-chain finite product frame, provides a full graded polynomial and rational bivariate GF, all attainable ranks and sharp end ranks. The result is strictly finer than the known total sequence; it is a useful finite-modal counting benchmark and a clean structural normal form.
